03. 1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and State.
2. Instant petition is filed for release of the petitioner on bail in connection with C.T. Case No.177 of 2024 arising out of Komna P.S. Case No.177 of 2024 pending in the file of learned J.M.F.C.-
cum-G.N.A., Komna on the grounds stated therein.

3. Perused the FIR as at Annexure-1 and rejection order i.e. Annexure-2.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was in a relationship with the victim and under the circumstances and on account of the alleged mischief, at last, the report was lodged.

It is submitted that an offence under Section 376 IPC has been ruled out since in the meantime, with the closure of investigation, chargesheet is filed under Section 493 IPC with other allied offences against the petitioner and the co-accused.

With the above submission and by claiming that it was on account of a relationship that the victim was allegedly subjected to the mischief and for the reason that the act of the rape is excluded with the submission of chargesheet,
the petitioner, who is in custody from 2nd August, 2024 should be allowed to go on bail subject to any conditions, however, the same is objected to by Mr. Singh, learned ASC for the State with the claim that he is also responsible for having viralled the photographs of the victim in the locality.
5. On perusal of the materials on record, the Court finds that the relationship was developed between the parties but finally the report was lodged.

other relevant documents and statements of the witnesses recorded under Section 185 BNS are filed.
The offence under Section 376 IPC is not established as the petitioner stands chargesheeted in the meantime without any such offence of rape being alleged.

Considering the details of allegations and circumstances leading to the lodging of the report against the petitioner and co-accused, the Court is of the view that the petitioner should be allowed to go on bail subject to following conditions.
6. Accordingly, it is ordered.

7. In the result, the petition stands disposed of with a direction to release the petitioner on bail in connection with C.T. Case No.177 of 2024 arising out of Komna P.S. Case No.177 of 2024 subject to him furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/- (rupees fifty thousand) with one solvent surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned J.M.F.C.-cum-G.N.A., Komna, who shall be at liberty to impose such other suitable conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case besides the one that he shall not cause any harm to the victim or her family members in any manner, whatsoever, while on bail.
8. The BLAPL stands disposed of.
9. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
